documents.text: Photosynthesis uses sunlight to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugars. Chloroplasts containing chlorophyll carry out this process in green plants.
An ArangoDB backup exported by arangodump can be restored with arangorestore. Restore the dump into a separate empty test database before validating its collections and document counts.
Rust ownership and borrowing prevent use-after-free without a garbage collector. The borrow checker enforces reference lifetimes and restricts conflicting mutable and immutable borrows.

UTF-8 encodes Unicode characters, including accented French text such as café, Japanese characters such as 東京, and emoji such as 🚀. A composed é and a combining é have different byte sequences.
Banana bread uses ripe bananas, flour, eggs, and a raising agent. Mash the bananas before mixing the wet and dry ingredients, then bake the batter in a loaf pan.
An orbit combines gravitational attraction with tangential velocity. A satellite continually falls toward its planet while moving sideways fast enough to remain above the surface.
